public_thesis: TAXLANE can build a transparent fiscal operating model that calculates effective funding rates only after assigned bases, behavior, incidence, distribution, administration, interactions, outcome floors, fund accounting, reserves, emergencies, and endogenous net interest reconcile. Before those gates pass, the system can publish what is known, what is blocked, and what evidence is still needed.
non_claim_boundary: This is a role-reviewed public thesis packet, not a statutory-rate proposal, effective-rate publication, public rate card, tax proposal, savings estimate, waste finding, fraud finding, department-cut instruction, technology-savings claim, solver result, pilot selection, or balanced-budget claim. It explains the operating-system thesis and blockers only.

public_language_rules.rule: Use overspending risk, review-needed signal, or blocked/no-claim language unless separate positive evidence supports a stronger finding.
Never infer fraud from an international comparison, benchmark gap, or improper-payment estimate.

Technology modernization begins with implementation, training, cybersecurity, privacy, fallback, and service-risk costs. Lower funding may be recognized only after measured productivity and floors pass.
Explain that not calculated and blocked are first-class outcomes when assigned-base, scoring, distribution, or floor evidence is missing.

public_language_rules.required_phrase: fairness requires burden and distribution analysis
public_language_rules.rule: Fair rates require legal and economic perimeter, incidence, burden, distribution by income, compliance load, and beneficiary floor protection.

Do not claim balance until every budget row, fund, offset, reserve, emergency rule, interaction score, distribution score, macro feedback, endogenous interest path, and unrounded deficit gap reconcile.

allowed_content: why effective rates require assigned bases and reconciliation
why overspending risk signals are review screens
why modernization is modeled as a transition path
why some lanes remain not calculated or blocked
official cost, receipt, debt, and fund updates
distribution, behavior, macro, and interaction scoring
fund, reserve, offset, emergency, deficit-gap, and rounding reconciliation
role-reviewed public rate cards only where gates pass

role_review_summary.finding: Public thesis keeps taxpayer fairness tied to burden, distribution, compliance, and service floors.
Public thesis preserves all-receipt and residual-general-fund denominators, fund separateness, offsets, and explicit deficit-gap treatment.
No rate, risk, technology, savings, or balanced-budget claim may publish without custody, matched period, and evidence grade.
Public thesis distinguishes public goods, transfers, financing costs, service commitments, and modernization costs.
Any lower-cost or lower-rate recognition remains blocked unless access, quality, equity, adequacy/resilience, delivery feasibility, and lane-specific floors pass.
Assigned-base rates remain blocked until taxpayer, employer, agency, filing, withholding, avoidance, and compliance effects are modeled.
Balanced-budget language remains blocked until endogenous interest, reserves, emergencies, macro feedback, interaction scoring, and the unrounded deficit gap reconcile.
The packet demotes proof rhetoric into an auditable thesis and forces blocked/no-claim outcomes to remain visible.
